say:1:1322150001:1.text: Ah, dear friends! Welcome to St. Callahan's Temple.
say:1:1322150001:1.source_cn: 各位朋友，欢迎你们来圣杨凯维奇教堂参观！

say:2:1322150002:1.text: Congratulations on being made a resident acolyte here!
say:2:1322150002:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，恭喜你成为这里的驻堂修士！

say:3:1322150003:1.text: I really didn't expect the Divinum Centrum to send Dame Temesia here. But Whiteridge has been through so much, and it truly needs someone of her stature to oversee the work here.
say:3:1322150003:1.source_cn: 真没想到圣堂会派特弥希娅大人前来。不过白山经历了这么一...

choice_prompt:4:1322150003.text: I really didn't expect the Divinum Centrum to send Dame Temesia here. But Whiteridge has been through so much, and it truly needs someone of her stature to oversee the work here.
choice_prompt:4:1322150003.source_cn: 真没想到圣堂会派特弥希娅大人前来。不过白山经历了这么一团乱七八糟的事情，确实需要一位大人物来主持这里的工作。

say:5:1322150005:1.text: Of course, I'll continue to work with the Graveborn to purify the undead souls that need to move on.
say:5:1322150005:1.source_cn: 当然，我会继续和那几位亡灵一起继续净化当地的活死人。

say:6:1322150006:1.text: Dura above, this is my way of showing respect and offering condolences to them.
say:6:1322150006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这也是我对他们的尊重和悼念。

choice:4:0:1.text: What are your plans going forward?
choice:4:0:1.male: What are your plans going forward?
choice:4:0:1.female: What are your plans going forward?

say:8:1322150004:1.text: My plans? Well, while managing the affairs of this temple, I plan to study and aim to become a priest soon.
say:8:1322150004:1.source_cn: 接下来？一边主持好这座教堂的事务，一边学习，希望能早点...

choice:4:1:2.text: About the purification of the undead...
choice:4:1:2.male: About the purification of the undead...
choice:4:1:2.female: About the purification of the undead...
